short_answer:
A 700B-class open model already runs on Kevin's 128 GB M5 Max by streaming its experts from the SSD. The ds4 maintainer measured full GLM 5.3 (753B, index 45) at IQ2_XXS (211 GB file) at 4.1-5.1 tok/s. On the same Mac, DeepSeek V4 Flash MXFP4 (Vision-Exp, 156 GB) streams at 12-19 tok/s with 263-300 tok/s prefill, and GLM-5.3-Flash Q4_K at 12-15 tok/s.

In memory:
- DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 ds4 Q2 (86.7 GB): measured 39.4 tok/s decode and 790 prefill at 2K; 27.6 / 399 at 64K. Index 34; fidelity KLD 0.41.
- gpt-oss-120b: 105 tok/s (community report).
- Qwen3-235B at 2-3 bits: estimate 27-38 tok/s short, 17-23 at 32K.
- GLM-5.3-Flash Q2 (96.5 GB, index 42): estimate 28-37, Tight.
All of these need other work stopped first: 57.6 GB was free when checked.

Kimi has no Mac streaming engine. ds4 does not list it, and stock mmap runs about 5x slower than pread. The smallest K2 files are 235-240 GB; native INT4 is 595 GB. Estimate for K2.6 Q2 (340.5 GB):
- 2.5-5.8 tok/s with a purpose-built streamer and all other work stopped;
- 1.4-3.0 at today's free memory;
- 0.5-1.4 with mmap;
- a 30K prompt takes 3-12 minutes.
The only 2-bit task data for Kimi is GSQ (CUDA only): K2.6 GPQA-D 87.21 to 83.16. The Q2 file fits on disk only if the 238 GB being freed comes on top of today's 203 GB. A 100 GB Kimi would at best be a coding specialist: Kimi K3 builds pruned more than 50% lose factual recall.
rejected: CL-09 (part): adopted the HBM unit fix, rejected its conclusion that the round-1 KV risk was 2x too pessimistic. MLA KV is copied to every TP rank (vLLM docs: TP8 causes 8x duplication), so per-GPU headroom is the limit and the risk is larger.

AR-13 (part): described the hit-copy and per-layer sync costs and reported the flash-moe back-test (25-32% optimistic), but did not add a fixed ~20% overhead to every estimate, because A6 fits the ds4 GLM 5.3 and V4 Flash back-tests without one. Stated as a downside risk instead.
AR-08 (part): did not adopt the alternative recommendation (V4 Flash Q4K streaming, 164.6 GB) because it has no Mac measurement; the recommendation now lists the three ds4-measured files.
NV-05 (part): did not adopt the V4 Flash per-mode GPQA figures (71.2 / 87.4 / 88.1). They came only from a search summary, and the 0731 card I read lists the reasoning levels but not those numbers.
NV-03 (part): Ex0bit K2.5 REAP saliency scores are used only as a cross-check, not as the starting point. They come from an abliterated variant and are pickle files.
CL-17 (adjusted): GLM-4.6 decode uses the measured 11.89 GB per token (24-32 tok/s), not the verifier's 32B x 1.89 bits (28-37), which omits the spine.
AR-01 (refined): V4 Flash ds4 Q2 reads 9.34 GB per token, not 9.57; the verifier's figure included the 1.99 GB MTP block, which ordinary decode does not use.
AR-10 / K4 (adjusted): K4 is 1.1-2.4 tok/s, not 1.2-2.8. The verifier's h 0.60-0.70 sits above the lowered A7 bracket (CL-22), so I used 0.55-0.65.
gaps_in_order: G2 (OPEN): Kimi K2 routing traces, cache hit rates, and whether a host-side emulator reproduces ds4's measured M5 Max streaming speeds and then predicts Kimi's. Uses stock SGLang's per_token recorder, event-atomic replay and diverse templates; about 13-51 GPU-hours, mostly runnable before GPU 0 frees on 2026-10-21.

G4 (PARTLY_DONE): task-level cost of 2-bit DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731, with every setting pinned to 0731. The AtomicChat fidelity ladder already exists. Adds a host kernel-path check (CUDA vs CPU) instead of a Mac check; about 18-137 GPU-hours; runs on GPUs 1-7.

G5 (PARTLY_DONE): Kimi K2 with top-6 and top-4 experts, testing standard and anchored renormalization (2609.25809, 2609.04575, SER prior work). KLD screen on the GGUF or GSQ checkpoint now; INT4 TP8 evaluation after 2026-10-21; about 29-314 GPU-hours.

G1 (PARTLY_DONE, reframed): can a Kimi K2.6 of 100 GB or less keep 90% or more on coding and tool use? GSQ 294 GB and REAP-50 288 GB already exist, and the K3 pruning evidence is the prior. About 54-306 GPU-hours on the k-quant route, plus 190-250 per GSQ configuration. Stage-1 stop rule.

G3 (OPEN, conditional on G1 Stage 1): compressed Kimi against V4 Flash 0731, GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, Qwen3-235B and gpt-oss at 105 GB or less. About 13-181 GPU-hours; otherwise a desk comparison.
